sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. After a recent loss, Sandbach will be looking to bounce back against struggling Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture between two mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to capitalise on any slip-up from the leaders. The title race could be influenced by AFC Bridgnorth's visit to Eccleshall—both are strong performers this season, with Eccleshall seeking to maintain their winning form. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in a local derby where the former sit two points ahead in fourth. At the foot of the table, Widnes Town (2 pts) host Brereton Social (11 pts) on Saturday in a clash between two struggling sides, while Telford Town travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads in another bottom-half fixture. Crewe host Allscott Heath on Saturday, with both sides looking for improvement after inconsistent recent runs. Foley Meir entertain Bilston Town in a mid-table contest, and Shawbury United host Barnton on Saturday with the former desperately seeking a win after six consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills in another fixture where both teams will be keen to climb away from the lower reaches. On Wednesday 7 October, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a midweek encounter.
